sources.title: GitHub - IBM/gguf: IBM GGUF-encoded AI models and conversion scripts
sources.snippet: This repository provides an automated CI/CD process to convert, test and deploy IBM Granite models, in safetensor format, from the ibm-graniteorganization to IBM GGUF versions (with various supported quantizations) within model repositories respectively named with the -GGUFextension. These GGUF model repositories are also included to the Granite Quantized Modelcollection for convenience.

sources.title: GGUF-Models (GGUF) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF is a modern file format for storing models optimized for efficient inference, particularly on consumer-grade hardware. This makes it easier for researchers, developers, and hobbyists to experiment with and deploy large language models.
